suggested_methods: Real examples: Guide pupils to identify the use of statistics (pie charts and bar graphs) to present information using real data
Project work: Guide pupils to find information in their community and present the information by means of bar graphs and pie charts
activities.assessment_criteria: The use of statistics to present information is identified accurately
suggested_resources: Charts of real statistics such as pie charts and bar graphs
online chart and graph making applications and geographical diagrams showing statistics
